records.name: GPT-4o
records.description: OpenAI's flagship multimodal model supporting text, image, audio input and output in a unified architecture. Serves as the primary model powering ChatGPT and is available via API for developers.

records.name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
records.description: Anthropic's flagship language model offering strong performance across coding, reasoning, instruction-following, and multimodal understanding. Available via API and as the default model powering claude.ai.

records.name: Gemini 1.5 Pro
records.description: Google DeepMind's long-context multimodal model supporting text, images, audio, video, and code with a 1 million-token context window. Accessible through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.

records.name: DeepSeek-R1
records.description: Open-weight reasoning model from DeepSeek using reinforcement learning to achieve strong performance on mathematics, coding, and logical reasoning tasks. Weights released under the MIT License.

records.name: Llama 3.1
records.description: Meta AI's family of open-weight large language models available in 8B, 70B, and 405B parameter sizes with a 128K token context window. Supports multilingual tasks, reasoning, coding, and tool use.

records.name: Mistral Large
records.description: Mistral AI's flagship proprietary language model for enterprise use, offering strong multilingual reasoning, coding, and instruction-following performance. Accessible via the Mistral API and La Plateforme.

records.name: Qwen2.5
records.description: Alibaba's Qwen2.5 series of open-weight language models available from 0.5B to 72B parameters, with strong performance in coding (Qwen2.5-Coder), mathematics (Qwen2.5-Math), and multilingual instruction following.

records.name: FLUX.1 [schnell]
records.description: Fast text-to-image diffusion model from Black Forest Labs designed for local inference, generating high-quality images in 1–4 steps using Latent Adversarial Diffusion Distillation. Released under Apache 2.0 license.

records.name: Whisper
records.description: Open-source automatic speech recognition model from OpenAI trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual audio data. Supports transcription and translation in 99+ languages. Weights freely available for local use.

records.name: text-embedding-3-large
records.description: OpenAI's high-performance text embedding model producing dense vector representations for semantic search, RAG, and classification tasks. Outperforms ada-002 on MTEB benchmarks with configurable output dimensions.

records.name: Stable Diffusion 3.5
records.description: Stability AI's text-to-image diffusion model featuring improved prompt adherence, image quality, and typography generation. Available in Large (8B) and Medium (2.5B) variants with weights downloadable under a community license.

records.name: Phi-3
records.description: Microsoft Research's family of small language models (3.8B–14B parameters) designed for efficient local inference on resource-constrained hardware. Offers strong reasoning performance relative to model size.

records.name: Command R+
records.description: Cohere's enterprise-focused language model optimized for RAG pipelines, tool use, and multi-step agent workflows. Supports 10+ languages and excels at instruction following for business applications.

records.name: BGE-M3
records.description: Multi-functionality, multi-linguality, and multi-granularity text embedding model from BAAI. Supports dense retrieval, sparse retrieval, and multi-vector retrieval in 100+ languages. Open-source under MIT License.

records.name: Falcon 180B
records.description: Open-weight large language model from the Technology Innovation Institute with 180 billion parameters, trained on 3.5 trillion tokens of the RefinedWeb dataset. Supports text generation and completion tasks.

records.name: MusicGen
records.description: Open-source text-to-music and melody-conditioned music generation model from Meta AI AudioCraft. Generates high-quality stereo audio from text descriptions and optional melodic conditioning inputs.

records.name: OpenAI o1
records.description: OpenAI's frontier reasoning model designed to spend inference time thinking before producing answers. Uses reinforcement learning to execute long chain-of-thought reasoning across competitive math, coding, and scientific research benchmarks.

records.name: Gemma 2
records.description: Family of lightweight open-weight models (2.6B, 9B, and 27B parameters) from Google DeepMind built upon Gemini research. Features sliding-window attention and knowledge distillation for exceptional single-GPU efficiency.

records.name: Claude 3.5 Haiku
records.description: Anthropic's fastest language model in the Claude 3.5 family. Delivers coding, text analysis, and instruction-following performance matching prior flagship Claude 3 Opus at high inference speeds and low per-token operational cost.

records.name: DeepSeek-V3
records.description: Open-weight 671-billion parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model (activating 37B parameters per token) developed by DeepSeek. Features Multi-head Latent Attention and auxiliary-loss-free load balancing for cost-effective inference.

records.name: Llama 3.2
records.description: Meta's multimodal open-weight collection offering 11B and 90B vision-language models alongside 1B and 3B lightweight edge text models. Optimized for mobile, on-device computing, and visual document analysis across 128K context windows.

records.name: Codestral
records.description: Mistral AI's 22-billion parameter open-weight language model trained on 80+ programming languages. Features a 32K context window with fill-in-the-middle capabilities for IDE autocompletions and codebase refactoring.

records.name: Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2)
records.description: Meta FAIR's foundation model for real-time visual promptable object segmentation across both static images and dynamic video frames, tracking target object masks continuously through occlusions and camera perspective shifts.

records.name: DINOv2
records.description: Vision foundation model developed by Meta FAIR using self-supervised learning without text supervision. Produces universal visual features for monocular depth estimation, semantic segmentation, and image retrieval.

records.name: CLIP
records.description: OpenAI's foundational vision-language model trained on 400 million image-text pairs via contrastive learning. Maps images and text into a shared embedding space to enable zero-shot image classification and semantic multimodal search.

records.name: HunyuanVideo
records.description: Tencent's 13-billion parameter open-source video generation model utilizing a unified dual-stream and single-stream diffusion transformer. Generates high-definition (720p/1080p) cinema-grade video clips with physical dynamics.

records.name: CogVideoX
records.description: Open-source text-to-video diffusion transformer model developed by THUDM and Zhipu AI. Employs 3D Variational Autoencoders and expert transformer backends to produce coherent 6-second video clips up to 4K resolution.

records.name: Voyage-3
records.description: High-performance text embedding model engineered by Voyage AI delivering top retrieval accuracy on the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB). Optimized for domain-specific RAG pipelines across finance, code, and legal documents.

records.name: Cohere Embed v3
records.description: Cohere's enterprise embedding model family supporting 100+ languages and multimodal image-text searches. Outperforms previous generations in noisy document retrieval using compression-aware quantization embeddings.

records.name: XTTS-v2
records.description: Deep learning text-to-speech foundation model from Coqui capable of realistic voice cloning across 17 languages from a 3-second audio reference sample without extensive speaker fine-tuning.

records.name: Mistral NeMo
records.description: 12-billion parameter multilingual foundation model co-developed by Mistral AI and NVIDIA. Features a 128K context window and the Tekken tokenizer for efficient multilingual inference and code synthesis.

records.name: Jina Embeddings v3
records.description: Open-source 570M parameter embedding model supporting 8192-token context lengths across 89 languages. Uses task-specific LoRA adapters to optimize vectors for retrieval, classification, clustering, and semantic matching.

records.name: Gemini 1.5 Flash
records.description: Google DeepMind's lightweight, low-latency multimodal foundation model. Optimized for high-frequency tasks, cost efficiency, and massive 1-million-token context processing across text, audio, images, and video feeds.

records.name: GPT-4o mini
records.description: OpenAI's cost-efficient small multimodal model replacing GPT-3.5 Turbo. Supports text and vision inputs with a 128K context window, scoring strongly on reasoning, coding, and mathematical benchmarks at a fraction of flagship model costs.

records.name: Qwen2.5-Coder
records.description: Code-specialized open-weight model series from Alibaba Cloud ranging from 0.5B to 32B parameters. Trained on 5.5 trillion tokens of source code, technical documentation, and synthetic coding datasets with a 128K context window.

records.name: Qwen2-VL
records.description: Vision-language model family from Alibaba (2B, 7B, 72B) featuring NaViT dynamic image resolution architecture. Accurately reads arbitrary aspect-ratio images, interprets fine document text, and parses video events with second-level grounding.

records.name: DeepSeek-Coder-V2
records.description: Open-source Mixture-of-Experts language model for code and mathematics supporting 338 programming languages and a 128K context window. Available in 16B (2.4B active) and 236B (21B active) parameter scales.

records.name: Pixtral 12B
records.description: 12-billion parameter multimodal language model trained by Mistral AI. Integrates a custom 400M parameter vision encoder to natively reason over arbitrary images, documents, and technical charts alongside natural text across a 128K context window.

records.name: FLUX.1 [dev]
records.description: 12-billion parameter open-weight rectified flow transformer model from Black Forest Labs. Delivers state-of-the-art text-to-image quality, photorealistic skin textures, accurate multi-word typography, and detailed prompt comprehension.

records.name: Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL)
records.description: Stability AI's flagship 3.5-billion parameter latent diffusion model engineered for native 1024x1024 resolution image generation. Uses a base model followed by an ensemble refiner model to render intricate backgrounds and realistic lighting.

records.name: Kolors
records.description: Open-source text-to-image diffusion model developed by Kuaishou's Kolors Team. Built with the ChatGLM language model as its text encoder to achieve nuanced bilingual understanding (Chinese and English) and high-quality typography rendering.

records.name: Bark
records.description: Transformer-based text-to-audio foundation model created by Suno. Generates realistic multilingual speech, non-verbal vocalizations (laughter, sighs, clearing throat), background ambient sounds, and basic music from text prompts.

records.name: Whisper large-v3-turbo
records.description: Fine-tuned, pruned variant of OpenAI's Whisper large-v3 model. Reduces the number of decoder layers from 32 to 4 to deliver an 8x speedup in multilingual audio transcription and translation with minimal loss in accuracy.

records.name: BGE Reranker-v2
records.description: Multilingual cross-encoder reranking model series (m3 and gemma variants) developed by the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence. Computes deep relevance scores between queries and retrieved passages to dramatically boost RAG precision.

records.name: Cohere Rerank 3
records.description: Enterprise cross-encoder foundation model from Cohere engineered for semantic reranking of search results across 100+ languages, semi-structured JSON objects, emails, code snippets, and noisy web documents.

records.name: InternVL 2.0
records.description: Open-source multimodal foundation model family developed by OpenGVLab ranging from 1B to 108B parameters. Achieves top scores in multimodal benchmarks, chart understanding, OCR, document analysis, and video grounding.

records.name: Molmo 72B
records.description: Open multimodal vision-language model developed by the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2). Outperforms proprietary models on academic benchmarks using open datasets and transparent human-collected visual pointing annotations.

records.name: Moondream2
records.description: Compact 1.6-billion parameter vision-language model engineered to run locally on edge hardware, mobile phones, and Raspberry Pi devices. Capable of visual question answering, image captioning, and object detection.

records.name: OpenAI o3-mini
records.description: OpenAI's cost-efficient reasoning model engineered for STEM tasks, competitive coding, and multi-step mathematics. Features user-configurable reasoning effort levels (low, medium, high) and supports developer tool-calling within chain-of-thought workflows.

records.name: Llama 3
records.description: Meta AI's foundational open-weight language model family released in 8B and 70B parameter architectures. Trained on over 15 trillion tokens using custom GPU clusters, establishing early industry benchmarks for open-weights performance.

records.name: Mistral 7B
records.description: Foundational 7.3-billion parameter open-weight language model from Mistral AI. Employs Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) and Sliding Window Attention (SWA) to deliver high inference throughput and outscore larger 13B models across benchmarks.

records.name: Mixtral 8x7B
records.description: High-performance sparse Mixture-of-Experts model from Mistral AI with 46.7B total parameters. Routes each token through 2 of 8 expert subnetworks (activating 12.9B parameters per token) to deliver 70B-grade reasoning at 14B execution speeds.

records.name: Mixtral 8x22B
records.description: Large-scale sparse Mixture-of-Experts model from Mistral AI with 141B total parameters, activating 39B parameters per token. Features a 64K token context window, native function calling, and strong multilingual mathematical reasoning.

records.name: Qwen2.5-Math
records.description: Open-weight specialized mathematical model family from Alibaba Cloud (1.5B, 7B, 72B). Trained exclusively on mathematical web text, synthesis datasets, and step-by-step chain-of-thought proofs to solve advanced competition-grade problems.

records.name: DeepSeek-V2.5
records.description: Open-source foundation model from DeepSeek that unifies general conversational capabilities from DeepSeek-V2-Chat with coding reasoning from DeepSeek-Coder-V2 into a single 236B Mixture-of-Experts architecture.

records.name: Gemma
records.description: Google DeepMind's first-generation suite of lightweight open-weight models (2B and 7B parameters) built from Gemini research, engineered for responsible AI development, text completion, and on-device execution.

records.name: Stable Audio Open
records.description: Open-weight audio generation model by Stability AI capable of generating up to 47 seconds of high-fidelity 44.1kHz stereo audio, ambient sound effects, musical instrument samples, and Foley sounds from text descriptions.
records.family: Open Audio & Sound Effect Generation Model

records.name: Stable Video Diffusion (SVD)
records.description: Open-weight latent video diffusion model developed by Stability AI that generates smooth 14 to 25-frame video clips from single static images, supporting camera trajectory controls, motion conditioning, and multi-view generation.

records.name: Minitron
records.description: Family of compact language models (4B and 8B) created by NVIDIA through structured depth and width pruning of larger Llama 3.1 and Nemotron foundation models, fine-tuned with knowledge distillation for high edge efficiency.
records.family: Pruned & Distilled Edge Language Model Family

records.name: Jukebox
records.description: OpenAI's generative neural network for music that produces songs in raw audio format across diverse genres and artist styles, synthesizing singing vocals, lyrics, and complex musical instrumentation simultaneously.
records.family: Neural Network for Raw Audio Music Generation

records.name: E5 Embeddings
records.description: Family of dense text embedding models developed by Microsoft Research using weakly-supervised contrastive pre-training on billions of text pairs (CCPairs), consistently ranking among top models on the MTEB benchmark.

records.name: Nomic Embed Text
records.description: High-performance text embedding model with an 8192-token context window developed by Nomic AI. Completely reproducible with fully open model weights, training codebase, and raw training dataset.
records.family: Fully Open-Source Long-Context Text Embedding Model

records.name: YOLOv8
records.description: Real-time computer vision model family created by Ultralytics. Provides state-of-the-art speeds and accuracy across object detection, instance segmentation, oriented bounding box detection, pose estimation, and image classification.

records.name: Grounding DINO
records.description: Open-set object detection foundation model developed by IDEA-Research. Marries DINO vision transformer detection with language grounding to detect arbitrary objects in images specified by free-form human text queries.

records.name: Phi-4
records.description: 14-billion parameter open-weight language model developed by Microsoft Research. Trained on synthetic reasoning datasets and curated textbook content, achieving state-of-the-art performance on mathematical and logical benchmarks rivaling models several times its size.

records.name: CodeGemma
records.description: Family of lightweight open-weight models from Google DeepMind specialized for code generation and completion (2B, 7B). Trained on 500+ billion tokens of English web text, mathematics, and code to deliver fast fill-in-the-middle IDE suggestions.

records.name: StarCoder2
records.description: Next-generation open-access code model family (3B, 7B, 15B parameters) developed by the BigCode Project, ServiceNow, and Hugging Face. Trained on the responsibly curated Stack v2 dataset across 600+ programming languages.

records.name: DeepSeek-VL2
records.description: Advanced open-weight vision-language model family from DeepSeek built on a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. Excels at high-resolution visual processing, technical diagram comprehension, document OCR, and grounded visual reasoning.

records.name: LLaVA-NeXT
records.description: Leading open-source large multimodal model architecture developed by academic researchers. Employs dynamic high-resolution image tiling to dramatically improve visual document understanding, OCR accuracy, and multimodal conversation.

records.name: Florence-2
records.description: Lightweight vision foundation model developed by Microsoft with a unified prompt-based representation. Handles diverse computer vision tasks including captioning, object detection, dense region descriptions, and visual grounding with a single model.

records.name: Segment Anything Model 1 (SAM 1)
records.description: Meta FAIR's foundational computer vision model for image segmentation. Trained on the SA-1B dataset of 1 billion masks, it cuts out any object in any image with a single interactive foreground point or bounding box prompt.

records.name: Depth Anything V2
records.description: State-of-the-art monocular depth estimation foundation model developed by ByteDance and the University of Hong Kong. Predicts robust, high-granularity metric and relative depth maps from arbitrary indoor and outdoor images.

records.name: FastSAM
records.description: High-speed, real-time approximation of the Segment Anything task formulated using the YOLOv8-seg instance segmentation architecture. Delivers 50x faster inference speeds than SAM, running at real-time video framerates.

records.name: Stable Diffusion 2.1
records.description: Open text-to-image latent diffusion model released by Stability AI. Trained using an OpenCLIP text encoder to generate 768x768 resolution images, supporting depth-guided generation and text-conditioned inpainting pipelines.

records.name: ControlNet
records.description: Neural network architecture that adds spatial conditioning controls to text-to-image diffusion models. Locks original model weights while training trainable copies to guide generations using edge maps, human pose skeletons, or depth maps.
records.family: Spatial Conditioning Architecture for Diffusion Models

records.name: AnimateDiff
records.description: Motion-conditioned animation module that transforms personalized text-to-image diffusion checkpoints into smooth animated video generators without requiring task-specific fine-tuning of the base image weights.
records.family: Text-to-Video Motion Module for Diffusion Models

records.name: TripoSR
records.description: Fast feed-forward 3D reconstruction model co-developed by Stability AI and VAST AI. Generates textured 3D polygon meshes from a single 2D image in less than 0.5 seconds on consumer GPUs without multi-step optimization.

records.name: InstantMesh
records.description: Open-source feed-forward framework developed by Tencent ARC for generating high-quality textured 3D meshes from a single image in approximately 10 seconds. Combines multi-view diffusion with sparse-view large reconstruction transformers.

records.name: Chronos
records.description: Family of pretrained foundation models developed by Amazon Science for probabilistic time-series forecasting. Tokenizes real-valued time-series data into discrete scaling bins, training autoregressive T5 architectures for zero-shot forecasting.
records.family: Pretrained Time-Series Forecasting Foundation Model Family

records.name: WhisperX
records.description: High-performance speech recognition pipeline built upon Whisper. Integrates forced phoneme alignment using wav2vec 2.0 and voice activity detection (PyAnnote) to deliver 70x faster-than-real-time transcription with precise word timestamps and speaker diarization.

records.name: PaliGemma 2
records.description: Google's lightweight open vision-language model family combining a SigLIP vision encoder with Gemma 2 language models across 3B, 10B, and 28B parameter checkpoints for image captioning, VQA, OCR, and spatial object detection.

records.name: SmolLM2
records.description: Hugging Face's lightweight open-weight language model family available in 135M, 360M, and 1.7B parameter sizes, pre-trained on high-quality synthetic datasets and designed for on-device inference in resource-constrained environments.

records.name: ESM3
records.description: Frontier biological foundation model from EvolutionaryScale that simultaneously reasons over protein sequence, 3D structure, and biological function to generate novel functional proteins and advance programmable biology.

records.name: AlphaFold 3
records.description: DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs breakthrough model predicting the 3D structures and interactions of all life molecules, including proteins, DNA, RNA, ligands, and chemical modifications with atomic accuracy.

records.name: SeamlessM4T
records.description: Meta AI's unified foundational speech and text model capable of speech-to-speech, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and text-to-text translation across nearly 100 spoken languages with expressive voice preservation.

records.name: OpenVoice
records.description: Open-source voice cloning model from MyShell and MIT that replicates a speaker's unique vocal timbre from a short audio snippet while providing flexible, independent control over emotion, accent, rhythm, and language.

records.name: Solar 10.7B
records.description: High-performing open-weights language model built by Upstage using Depth Up-Scaling (DUS) methodology, combining modified base layers to outscore larger models on reasoning, instruction compliance, and mathematical benchmarks.

records.name: MiniCPM-V
records.description: Open-source multimodal foundation model series designed by OpenBMB and Tsinghua for efficient on-device vision-language tasks, high-resolution document parsing, spatial bounding box detection, and live video stream understanding.

records.name: Video-LLaVA
records.description: Multimodal alignment model that binds images and video representations into a unified feature space before projecting them into an LLM, enabling synchronized spatio-temporal reasoning, video captioning, and conversational video QA.

records.name: BioGPT
records.description: Microsoft Research's specialized domain-specific generative language model pre-trained on massive collections of PubMed biomedical literature, excelling at biomedical relation extraction, text classification, and medical question answering.

records.name: Command R
records.description: Cohere's 35B parameter open-weights foundation model optimized specifically for enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-step tool interactions, and grounded text generation across 10 global business languages.

records.name: MMS (Massively Multilingual Speech)
records.description: Meta AI's speech technology suite providing automatic speech recognition for over 1,100 languages, text-to-speech for over 1,400 languages, and language identification across 4,000 spoken languages.

records.name: Falcon 2 11B
records.description: Second-generation foundational model from the Technology Innovation Institute (TII) combining state-of-the-art 11B language reasoning with native vision-to-language capabilities for document understanding and visual question answering.

records.name: SegFormer
records.description: NVIDIA's lightweight, hierarchical vision transformer framework for semantic image segmentation that removes complex positional embeddings and yields high-accuracy multi-scale feature representations for autonomous driving and robotics.

records.name: InternVideo2
records.description: Large-scale foundation video model developed by OpenDataLab and Shanghai AI Lab that learns multi-modal representations for video-audio-text retrieval, action localization, fine-grained event parsing, and long-form video reasoning.

records.name: Qwen2-Audio
records.description: Alibaba Cloud's audio-language model capable of directly ingesting complex voice, environmental sounds, and musical audio streams to perform speech recognition, sound event detection, emotion classification, and vocal chat.

records.name: Med-PaLM 2
records.description: Expert-level medical foundation model developed by Google Research, fine-tuned on clinical medical knowledge to answer healthcare queries, interpret clinical documentation, and achieve expert-level passing scores on USMLE medical exams.

records.name: Code Llama
records.description: Meta AI's family of open code models built on Llama 2 checkpoints, available in 7B, 13B, 34B, and 70B parameter sizes, trained on 500B tokens of code and syntax to generate, debug, explain, and autocomplete code across Python, C++, Java, and Bash.

records.name: DeepSeek-Math
records.description: Open mathematical reasoning model developed by DeepSeek pre-trained on 120B math-related tokens from web text and literature, utilizing Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to reach competition-level mathematics accuracy.

records.name: LLaVA-1.5
records.description: Seminal open-source multimodal visual assistant combining a CLIP-ViT-L-336px vision encoder with Vicuna LLMs using a simple MLP projection layer, setting the architectural blueprint for open vision-language models.

records.name: MusicLM
records.description: Google Research's conditional hierarchical sequence-to-sequence model generating high-fidelity 24 kHz music from complex natural language descriptions, humming melodies, or whistle inputs across diverse genres.

records.name: DBRX
records.description: Databricks' 132B total parameter open Mixture-of-Experts language model activating 36B parameters across 16 fine-grained experts per token, delivering competitive efficiency and accuracy across programming and general knowledge benchmarks.

records.name: SD-Turbo (Stable Diffusion Turbo)
records.description: Fast text-to-image foundation model by Stability AI based on Adversarial Diffusion Distillation (ADD), enabling real-time photorealistic single-step image generation at 512x512 resolution with near-zero latency.

records.name: Latent Consistency Models (LCM)
records.description: High-speed generative distillation architecture that predicts solution trajectories in latent space, shrinking the generation process of Stable Diffusion from 25–50 sampling steps down to just 2 to 4 inference steps.

records.name: Distil-Whisper
records.description: Knowledge-distilled version of OpenAI's Whisper model designed by Hugging Face that runs 6x faster and is 50% smaller while maintaining within 1% Word Error Rate (WER) of the original Whisper-Large models.

records.name: NV-Embed
records.description: NVIDIA's frontier generalist text embedding model that achieved top ranking on the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB), incorporating latent attention pooling and bidirectional instruction-aware tuning.

records.name: InstructPix2Pix
records.description: Pioneering conditional diffusion model trained on paired synthetic data generated by GPT-3 and Stable Diffusion to perform precise image editing directly from conversational instructions without masking.

records.name: CogView3
records.description: Zhipu AI and Tsinghua University's open text-to-image diffusion model based on cascaded diffusion architectures, generating high-fidelity Chinese and English photorealistic visual imagery and graphic typography.

records.name: YOLOS
records.description: Pure Vision Transformer (ViT) architecture adapted for 2D object detection from Huazhong University and ByteDance, discarding convolutional backbones and region proposals in favor of standard sequence-to-sequence representations.
records.family: Pure Vision Transformer Object Detection Model

records.name: TimesNet
records.description: Foundation deep learning framework for general time series analysis that transforms 1D temporal sequences into 2D tensor spaces based on multiple periodicities, capturing both intraperiod and interperiod variations for forecasting and anomaly detection.

records.name: CosyVoice
records.description: Alibaba Tongyi Lab's open-source multi-lingual generative speech model capable of zero-shot voice cloning with 3 seconds of reference audio, natural conversational prosody control, and multi-dialect voice synthesis.

records.name: Yi-Coder
records.description: Open coding foundation model series by 01.AI available in 1.5B and 9B parameter sizes, trained on 2.4 trillion tokens and supporting long context lengths up to 128K tokens for repository-level comprehension and code generation across 52 languages.

records.name: Llama 2
records.description: Meta AI's milestone open foundation model family available in 7B, 13B, and 70B parameter checkpoints, trained on 2 trillion tokens to establish the modern standard for open-weights research and commercial deployment.

records.name: Mistral Small
records.description: Cost-efficient, enterprise-grade language model by Mistral AI engineered for low-latency reasoning, code generation, and function calling across multiple European and global languages.

records.name: DeepSeek-Coder
records.description: First-generation open coding model family by DeepSeek (1.3B, 6.7B, 33B) trained from scratch on 2 trillion tokens of 87 programming languages with 16K project-level context windows and fill-in-the-middle support.

records.name: Claude 3 Opus
records.description: Anthropic's flagship high-intelligence model in the Claude 3 family, demonstrating near-human levels of comprehension and fluency across complex analysis, research synthesis, and specialized STEM reasoning tasks.

records.name: GPT-4 Turbo
records.description: OpenAI's high-capacity generative model supporting a 128K token context window, updated knowledge base, JSON mode, and unified vision and text processing capabilities for complex enterprise workloads.

records.name: Gemini 2.0 Flash
records.description: Google's high-speed multimodal reasoning model designed for the agentic era, featuring native real-time audio and video streaming input/output, sub-second latency, and built-in tool execution capabilities.

records.name: HQ-SAM (High-Quality SAM)
records.description: Upgraded segmentation model developed by ETH Zurich that enhances Meta's SAM with a High-Quality Output Token, generating extremely precise boundary segmentations for intricate objects like hair, ropes, and transparent items.

records.name: BLIP-2
records.description: Salesforce Research's foundational vision-language architecture using a Querying Transformer (Q-Former) to bridge frozen pre-trained vision encoders with frozen large language models with exceptional compute efficiency.

records.name: InstructBLIP
records.description: Instruction-tuned vision-language model by Salesforce Research that incorporates instruction-aware visual feature extraction to understand complex multimodal user directions across 26 vision tasks.

records.name: Open-Sora
records.description: Open-source video generation initiative developed by HPC-AI Tech that democratizes efficient video diffusion models using Spatial-Temporal Diffusion Transformers (STDiT) to generate high-resolution video clips.

records.name: Stable Cascade
records.description: Stability AI's high-efficiency text-to-image foundation model built on the Würstchen architecture, utilizing a 42x compression latent stage to generate high-resolution 1024x1024 images faster and with less VRAM than standard models.

records.name: SV3D (Stable Video 3D)
records.description: Generative 3D model by Stability AI that transforms single still images into continuous 360-degree orbital novel view videos and exportable 3D textured meshes using camera-conditioned video diffusion.
records.family: Generative Orbital Novel View & 3D Mesh Synthesis Model

records.name: Point-E
records.description: OpenAI's foundational 3D generation system that produces 3D colored point clouds from complex text prompts or 2D images in one to two minutes on a single GPU using two-stage diffusion pipelines.

records.name: Shap-E
records.description: OpenAI's conditional diffusion model that generates the parameters of implicit functions (rendering both Neural Radiance Fields and textured 3D meshes) directly from text prompts or single images.

records.name: Conformer-CTC
records.description: NVIDIA NeMo's high-speed automatic speech recognition model family combining self-attention for global audio context with depthwise convolution layers to capture fine-grained local speech acoustics.

records.name: UniAudio
records.description: Universal foundation model developed by Chinese University of Hong Kong that unifies 11 diverse audio generation and understanding tasks (ASR, TTS, sound generation, music editing, audio captioning) using discrete audio tokenization.
records.family: Universal Generative Audio & Speech Foundation Model

records.name: StarCoder
records.description: First-generation 15.5B parameter code generation foundation model developed by BigCode (Hugging Face & ServiceNow), trained on 1 trillion tokens across 80+ programming languages with 8K context and multi-query attention.

records.name: CodeGeeX4
records.description: Open code generation foundation model series (9B parameters) developed by Zhipu AI, pre-trained on the GLM-4 architecture with 128K context support for repository-scale code completion, debugging, and cross-language translation.

records.name: Snowflake Arctic
